scientific_status: This corpus was already opened for selector-v1 evaluation before selector v2 was frozen. Therefore this is a post-hoc regression screen only and cannot be cited as independent validation for selector v2.

long_context_gate_check.window_definition: For g2/g3 the diagnostic uses 16-beat windows with 8-beat stride, so four complete windows require at least 40 grid beats.
long_context_gate_check.verification_method: The aggregate V1 artifact does not retain per-grid window counts. For each segment, floor((end-start)/(60/bpm)) is a phase-independent lower bound on grid-beat count. None of the 15 raw cross-periodicity matches reached 40; the maximum lower bound was 36. Therefore no segment can satisfy the frozen four-window V2 gate.

raw_pair_adversarial_observation.note: The length/window gate is materially safety-relevant. If it were removed, the raw periodicity pair would fire on severe negative examples in this already-open corpus.

guardrails: Do not loosen or remove V2's long-context gate based on this corpus.
Do not move the V2 periodicity thresholds from this corpus.
Do not describe zero triggers here as validation or a pass.
Any V2 validation claim requires a newly frozen independent holdout selected before V2 Analyzer-derived evidence from that holdout is inspected.
